label: At GO in the last ~7 trials, after an a2-S2 win, growing toward episode end.
terms: (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (ep_trial - 90) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (prev_action == 2)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.4% of steps), silent at D1 and D2. It fires only at GO near the end of the episode (from about trial 93) when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 (common) rewarded, i.e. an S2 win-stay. Its magnitude grows with episode trial (~1.2 at t93 to ~2.0 at t99). Other previous-trial patterns, including a1 -> S2 rewarded and a2 -> S1 rare rewarded, give nothing. The free fit adds only a little: a negative belief_lo tilt (stronger when the observer is sure S2 is good) and prev_action offsets. Belief, the trial before and since_rev added under 0.01 dev R^2 beyond the ramp. The test R^2 drops from dev (0.57 to 0.36), probably because the feature is so rare. Some residual comes from window-first trials, where the previous trial pattern is unknown to last_is but the feature still fires.
